answer: Give each agent a private spectral watermark: the coordinator hides a violet-band tag, keyed to that agent stake seed, inside every task signal it sends, and pays only outputs that echo the same tag back. Clones that copy a sibling work repeat its tag, so the ledger sees shared provenance and merges their payout slots into one. A sable fleet of lookalike agents must run genuinely separate instances to earn distinct watermarks, or its clones collapse into a single voice.
